sentences.english: In the morning Ardi wakes up early.
Grandmother makes tea in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Ajo i jep çaj dhe bukë.
sentences.english: She gives him tea and bread.

sentences.text: Ardi pi çaj dhe ha bukë.
sentences.english: Ardi drinks tea and eats bread.
The dog is in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Pastaj Ardi shkon në shkollë me gjyshin.
sentences.english: Then Ardi goes to school with his grandfather.
